objective: How long a twelve-step journey takes from queued to verdict
input: Ten executions of the same unedited test
expected: Ten passing runs, with their durations recorded
detail: queued to verdict: median 2059ms (min 2056ms, p95 2062ms, max 2062ms, n=10); in the browser: median 1148ms (min 1037ms, p95 1203ms, max 1203ms, n=10); platform overhead about 911ms; about 96ms per step
